files.patch:
@@ -4361,0 +4361,18 @@
+# 0: name
+compiler.err.illegal.primitive.class.name=\
+    illegal name for a primitive class: {0}\n\
+    (it can contain only lowercase letters and digits)
+
+# 0: symbol
+compiler.err.primitive.class.must.declare.public.no.arg.constructor=\
+    primitive class {0} must declare a public no-argument constructor
+
+# 0: type
+compiler.err.illegal.primitive.class.field.type=\
+    illegal type for an instance field of a primitive class: {0}\n\
+    (it must be a primitive type or a primitive class type)
+
+# 0: symbol
+compiler.err.cyclic.primitive.class.membership=\
+    cyclic primitive class membership involving {0}
+
